title: T16b: daily-summary 1.1.0 with a model-written summary
head: codex/t16b-daily-summary
body:
## What

Added model-written summaries to daily-summary skill.

- Version 1.1.0 in `shared/daily-summary/skill.yaml`
- New `summarize` step using `model.daily_summary`
  - Placed between `get_unread` and `write_summary`
  - Model generates at most three lines from read steps' data (#51)
  - Never reads beyond provided data
- Schedule: `30 7 * * 1-5` (Mon–Fri, 7:30 AM)
- Budget: `max_usd: 0.05`, `max_seconds: 60`
- Resources: `shared: [connector:outlook, connector:outlook-calendar]`
- Done when: "A note for today exists with a short summary and today's meeting and unread counts"
- `SKILL.md`: subjects to model only, never to logs or email bodies
- Fixtures `case-1` through `case-3`: updated with fake data
- `docs/formats.md`: documents optional `resources` field
- `src/almanac/runner.py`: fixture replay gives scheduler connector limits from skill declaration
- New test for connector limit behavior

Pairs with agent-core and connectors T16b PRs.

## Checks (rerun by coordinator)

- `pytest -q` → 12 passed
- `ruff check .` → All checks passed
- `ruff format --check .` → 13 files already formatted
- `mypy --strict src` → no issues (native and `--platform win32`)
- `git diff --check` → clean
